title: Research: refine selected1094 conditional kappa on a 24-digit grid
body:
## Summary

The exact gain is `10293/15625000000000000000000 = 6.58752e-19`. This is a tiny final-grid precision refinement, not a changed supplier or mechanism. Stronger pending proposals are not used as selected science. The package includes the proof, exact source bytes, complete bill, strict arithmetic certificate, reproduction and Open next questions.

Canonical base `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, revision 6; publication commit `7ed071d5ba741ffd05f1b68c6fd7f8dcc6a12ad7`; scientific commit `b7d9770b3150a43f8661a73ed60c83185ec33fe6`. The complete cost delta is zero because no finite word, frame, state, recursive child, consumer, hosting, precision or compiler contract changes. Both original paid moments, BIT bad-residue surcharge and all selected finite charges remain present. No all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic-transfer or BIT H1-H5 assumption is newly discharged.

## Evidence

- Before: the selected final release uses an 18-decimal grid. The exact selected 47-row witness is reproduced.
- After: both interval engines accept the unchanged complex and BIT endpoints and reject their successor grid points; all 9 finite guards, seven bootstrap steps and 47 strict outer rows pass at the candidate. The next 24-decimal κ point fails the compact-phase inequality. Exact transfer absorption gap is positive, approximately 6.788001120269902e-25.
- Actual committed regular-only, inode-disjoint, read-only Git-free export passes the registered argv under CPython 3.12.15 and the documented optimized direct command under CPython 3.13.16, with TMPDIR unset. Private changed-source and false-versus-zero certificate controls reject in both normal/optimized modes.
- Designated internal review receipt is retained verbatim in REVIEW.json. This is scoped computational review, not human, proof-kernel or selected-result admission. No full selected cold/native/Lean/Docker replay was run.

python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected1094-release-grid
python3 -Werror -B research/selected1094-release-grid/verify.py

Blast radius: package. Source authentication and finite arithmetic do not prove the inherited physical/all-size framework. The preserved byte-identical vendor engine retains its existing trailing blank line; other new files pass whitespace checks.
